2. cmd/form4-watcher: polls EDGAR submissions API for Form 4 filings per watchlisted CIK, fetches XML, parses transactions, emits insider_buy and insider_sell_cluster signals to var/entity-graph/signals.ndjson. Deduplicates by accession number across poll cycles.
